test.create_query: CREATE TABLE vq_flat (id UInt32, i8 Array(BFloat16) CODEC(Quantized('int8', 768)), pb Array(BFloat16) CODEC(Quantized('prefix', 768, 256, 'bf16')), pi Array(BFloat16) CODEC(Quantized('prefix', 768, 256, 'int8'))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO vq_flat SELECT id, v, v, v FROM (SELECT number AS id, arrayMap(i -> toBFloat16((toInt64(sipHash64(number, i) % 2001) - 1000) / 1000.), range(768)) AS v FROM numbers_mt(300000)) SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT id FROM vq_flat ORDER BY cosineDistance(i8, arrayMap(i -> toBFloat16(sin(i)), range(768))) LIMIT 10 SETTINGS vector_search_use_quantized_codes = 1, vector_search_index_fetch_multiplier = 1 FORMAT Null
